title: `cargo check --all-features -p tokio` does not compile on stable

title: SemaphorePermit::merge can overflow and lose permits
author: Rachit2323
body_preview: **Version** tokio master (latest)  **Platform** Any. Tested on the Rust Playground.  **Description**  `SemaphorePermit::merge` just adds the two permit counts together with a plain `+`:      self.permits += other.permits;  `permits` is a `u32`, so if the two counts add up to more than ~4.29 billion, it overflows.
